codeReview.summary: Thorough and well-executed dead code cleanup. The worker removed 2,171 lines across 40 files, covering all specified targets plus additional dead code discovered during the process (22 dead katla_app items, 5 dead katla_gfx items, is_persistent getter). All 1,091 tests pass with zero compiler warnings. The worker correctly identified that SSE Quat was live code (not dead) and only removed the redundant #[allow(dead_code)] annotations. The entities module was properly inlined rather than just deleted. Targeted #[allow(dead_code)] annotations were added where justified (SkeletalAnimationSystem.sample_buffer, scalar::quat module, GPU layout structs in storage_uniform.rs).

issues.description: FrameUniforms and ObjectUniforms structs still have #[allow(dead_code)] annotations. The validation contract says 'dead storage_uniform structs removed' but these structs are actually USED (instantiated in update_frame_with_lighting and update_object_bindless). The annotations exist because the structs are pub but their fields are only written to GPU memory, not read by Rust code. This is acceptable - they serve as GPU buffer layout definitions. The truly dead ObjectData and ShaderMaterialParams structs were correctly removed.

is_persistent field has #[allow(dead_code)] after the public getter was removed. The field is set to true in new_persistent() but never read. Consider removing the field entirely since it's always true for the only constructor. However, this is a very minor issue and the targeted annotation is acceptable.
